case.title: The young star that went dark in 2011
case.hook: A famous, well-behaved young star that suddenly dimmed by two magnitudes and stayed dim for a decade.

query.adql: SELECT source_id, ra, dec, parallax, parallax_over_error, pmra, pmdec, ruwe, phot_g_mean_mag, phot_bp_mean_mag, phot_rp_mean_mag, bp_rp, phot_variable_flag, teff_gspphot, distance_gspphot, non_single_star, DISTANCE(POINT(68.73091745933,24.481398229049997), POINT(ra,dec))*3600 AS sep_arcsec FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE 1=CONTAINS(POINT(ra,dec), CIRCLE(68.73091745933,24.481398229049997,0.008333333333333333)) ORDER BY sep_arcsec

notes: rows_kept counts 6-month visits (W1 and W2), not exposures
observers (good points): MJB:720, HMB:354, DUBF:245, MZK:141, HMH:101, ROE:86, VMT:83, MGW:58, CIVA:45, WRCA:41, DKS:36, KTHC:16
upper limits, discrepant (val=T) and non-standard bands are kept but flagged; visual estimates form their own series 'Vis.'
no ZTF source (target may be brighter than ZTF saturation, ~12.5 mag)

checks.finding: 3 Gaia source(s) within 42.0"; brightest contributes 1.7% of the target's G flux at 24.8"

checks.finding: worst sector: 0.98 of aperture flux is from the target

checks.title: WISE saturation
checks.finding: 42 of 42 visits are at or brighter than saturation (W1<8, W2<7)

checks.title: NEOWISE single-exposure quality cuts
checks.finding: 270 exposures; cuts removed up to 77 (29%) per band; 0 visits kept with fewer than 3 exposures

checks.title: Independent optical confirmation
checks.finding: optical data from 12 independent source(s): AAVSO observer MJB (720), AAVSO observer HMB (354), AAVSO observer DUBF (245), AAVSO observer MZK (141), AAVSO observer HMH (101), AAVSO observer ROE (86), AAVSO observer VMT (83), AAVSO observer MGW (58), AAVSO observer CIVA (45), AAVSO observer WRCA (41), AAVSO observer DKS (36), TESS (214093)

checks.title: Does AAVSO start at the star's normal brightness?
checks.finding: first 60 days of V: median 15.03; Gaia DR3 (2014-17 mean) implies V = 15.57; difference -0.55 mag. The series begins mid-event: its own median is not the star's normal state.

checks.title: Multi-band consistency of the main event
Periodicity vs survey rhythms (AAVSO V)
checks.finding: strongest period 1115.67 d is not a known survey/Earth rhythm (not yet evidence it is real)

checks.title: Periodicity vs survey rhythms (TESS TESS)
checks.finding: strongest period 4.20 d is not a known survey/Earth rhythm (not yet evidence it is real)

checks.title: Gaia astrometric wobble (RUWE)
checks.finding: RUWE = 3.33 > 1.4: likely an unresolved companion, or a photocentre shifted by variability
